falsification_prediction: Train the whole-history ratio estimator on existing source-labelled PMFS trajectories and evaluate it on held-out complete episodes across the frozen PMFS rule grid against unchanged PMFS, a calibrated direct q0(y_t|g_t(s)) arm, and a field-only probabilistic learner. If the mechanism works, cumulative true-versus-fixed-rival log-odds margin increases and final true-source rank decreases relative to direct q0 without requiring an online candidate-response provider. The single load-bearing variable is delta_theta,t(s*,r), the difference of consecutive whole-history ratio-logit increments for the true source and a fixed rival. Destructively permuting measurement time-position assignments or independently permuting source-history pairings must drive cumulative fixed-rival margin and final rank back toward the direct-q0 or product-pair control; if intact and permuted arms are indistinguishable, or the ratio-moment and exact-equivariance checks fail, the claimed whole-history source-relative mechanism is falsified.
compute_budget: 24 GPU-days on one 80GB-class GPU for prefix training, checkpoint selection, and all held-out rule-grid/control arms; $0 paid API inference because all models, labels, and scoring are local.
what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to replace field-function scoring with balanced joint-source-history versus product-of-marginals prefix classification, then prior-normalize the resulting per-source density-ratio logits and test their fixed-rival increments under destructive history permutations.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: That method inserts a deterministic Green-function surrogate and its derivative into sparse source inversion, whereas this candidate learns an ordered-history source likelihood ratio and emits a normalized source map without online Green or candidate-response evaluation.

PNO learns a calibrated distribution over output functions with a proper field-space score, whereas this candidate's joint-versus-product objective estimates per-source history ratios whose prefix differences are evaluated directly against fixed rivals.

XIT consumes a supplied posterior mean-variance field for UCB planning, whereas this candidate replaces the updater itself with a source-relative probability map and makes no planning-improvement claim.

Abstract-only inference: that comparison selects uncertainty methods by field reconstruction and calibration, whereas this candidate trains and tests whole-history true-versus-rival likelihood-ratio increments before posterior normalization.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Paper-pointed threat: openalex:W4391952441 (collision_hits). This paper establishes that neural binary classifiers can approximate likelihood ratios through the likelihood-ratio trick, so the candidate cannot claim novelty for classifier-based density-ratio estimation itself. It does not subsume the candidate's narrower contribution because the retrieved result does not supply an ordered adaptive gas-history object, exact source-grid permutation equivariance, PMFS-prior normalization, prefix-difference fixed-rival evidence, or destructive history controls; the candidate explicitly labels neural ratio estimation as standard and makes those source-localization-specific elements carry the claim.
